profile_text.body:
Cognition is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as a team of interdisciplinary makers focused on what it calls the biggest shift in computing since the invention of software, working with enterprises and technology companies on AI development tools.

Cognition's primary product is Devin, which the company describes as the first autonomous software engineer. According to its site, Devin plans, writes, tests, and ships production code inside existing workflows. The held facts classify Devin as a security-critical system with full codebase access and high decision-influence. Cognition is also associated with Windsurf, an AI integrated development environment noted for source-code exposure considerations, listed under coding and developer tools.

The site's held facts indicate a notable legal exposure footprint, with 174 cases linked to California, though no specific litigation details are recorded. Cognition does not appear in the MCP server registry based on available data.
